d:
Watch the mesmerising "Gopikamma" video song from the movie, Mukunda! Featuring the charismatic pair of Varun Tej and Pooja Hegde, this foot-tapping track is composed by the talented Mickey.J.Meyer. Set against a vibrant backdrop, this Aditya Music presentation celebrates the beautiful Gopikamma in all her glory.
Song Name : Gopikamma
Movie Name : Mukunda
Banner : Leo Productions
Producer : B.Madhusudhana Reddy
Director : Srikanth Addala
Cast : Varun Tej,Pooja Hegde
Music : Mickey.J.Meyer
